responsibility: Implements construction of the built-in `BITSET` type and its `BITNUM` subrange in the gm2 symbol table. Using backend word-size information and the front end’s constant/value stack, it creates the set type, min/max constants, subrange bounds, and recorded size, so later semantic and code-generation code can treat `BITSET` as a predefined set over machine word bits.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the executable implementation for the M2Bitset interface: it computes `BITSET`/`BITNUM` using backend word-size information, creates the min/max constants and subrange/set types, and records size information that `M2Bitset.def` only advertises.
